heading: INT. CASSETTE ARCHIVE - BASEMENT OFFICE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CASSETTE ARCHIVE - BASEMENT OFFICE - NIGHT
A low room of grey metal shelves holding thousands of labeled tapes.
A bare bulb swings slightly, though no wind reaches down here.
Dust and old magnetic oxide.
A reel-to-reel and a cassette deck sit side by side on a cluttered desk beneath a corkboard of photographs strung together with red thread.
EVANGELINE ROTHCHILD-ADU, 50s, weary detective in a green cardigan, sits at the desk.
Her hair is pinned with a pencil.
She holds a microphone close to her lips, as though it were a confidant.
She presses record.
Case file nine-one-four. The Hargreave matter. Evening, third of November.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She lets go of the button.
Picks up a photograph.
Puts it down.
Presses again.
They told me the library caught fire by accident. I have read eleven reports that say so. Not one of them mentions the smell of kerosene, which three witnesses described independently.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She taps a thread on the corkboard.
The librarian, Mr. Quillfeather, vanished that night. His wife says he never returned. His employer says he resigned a week earlier. Both cannot be true.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She rewinds the cassette.
Plays it back.
...three witnesses described independently...
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She stops it.
Writes on a pad.
I found his key in the ash. A small brass key. It opens a locker in the basement of this very building. I've checked every locker. There isn't one.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She leans back.
Rubs her eyes.
Unless the basement I've been searching is the wrong basement.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: From somewhere in the stacks, a tape clicks and begins to turn.
She goes still.
Slowly lowers the microphone.
A voice fills the room from a distant shelf, on tape, calm and a little amused.
It is her own.
If you're hearing this, Evangeline, you've finally found the right basement.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: She stands.
The chair rolls back into a shelf, scattering tapes.
That's my voice.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: Third shelf on your left. Behind the tapes labeled Nineteen Seventy-Two.
units.name: EVANGELINE

units.text: Evangeline crosses.
Her heels click.
She pulls out box after box until a small brass-hinged door appears in the wall.
She takes the key from her cardigan pocket.
Her hand shakes.
She turns it.
The door opens.
Inside, nothing but a single reel marked: PLAY LAST.
